content: Current W3C WCAG 2.2 guidance: normal text needs 4.5:1 contrast (large text 3:1); meaningful control/state visuals need 3:1 against adjacent colors; keyboard-operable controls need persistent visible focus; and color cannot be the only visual means of conveying state or prompting action. Inactive controls are contrast-exempt but should remain programmatically disabled and visibly differentiated. Diff additions/deletions therefore retain +/- indicators and line-number/gutter structure; selected/comment/error states also use borders, icons, labels, or text.
